propositions: A test that drives the reconciler entrypoint in-process sets the rebar_reconciler root logger to WARNING level process-globally and never restores it, poisoning all later tests in the same xdist worker

caplog.at_level(INFO) with no logger argument cannot rescue an intermediate logger's WARNING level; it raises only the ROOT logger level, so INFO records are dropped at isEnabledFor before reaching caplog's handler
The existing log containment guard in conftest.py is hard-coded to the single rebar root and misses the sibling rebar_reconciler root, leaving reconciler-side INFO assertions unprotected

test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count fails intermittently under xdist when run after test_main_entry.py because the per-item WARNING line is captured but the summary INFO line is suppressed by the leaked rebar_reconciler logger level

The fix generalizes the caplog coverage-integrity guard to operate over both rebar and rebar_reconciler roots by snapshotting and restoring per-root levels in conftest.py, making log assertions order-independent
This is a test-infrastructure defect not a production one; when confirm_store is None the removal is applied not declined, so declined==0 and a suppressed summary is correct-by-design
